kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنتحب (form VIII)
# أَنْتَحِبُ (ʔantaḥibu) /ʔan.ta.ħi.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَحَبَ (intaḥaba)
# أَنْتَحِبَ (ʔantaḥiba) /ʔan.ta.ħi.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَحَبَ (intaḥaba)
# أَنْتَحِبْ (ʔantaḥib) /ʔan.ta.ħib/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْتَحَبَ (intaḥaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
